description: This file defines the MassUpdate class used in SuiteCRM for handling batch record updates, including generating forms for mass update, processing submitted data, and managing popup selection interfaces for linked modules. It includes methods for rendering forms, handling relationships, and applying updates across multiple records.

classes.name: MassUpdate
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate, handle, and process mass update forms for records in SuiteCRM, supporting linked module popups, data validation, and form rendering.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Sets the internal sugarbean object used for mass update operations.

methods.name: getDisplayMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for mass updating records, with options for multi-select and popup modes.

methods.name: getMassUpdateFormHeader
methods.description: Creates the header HTML for the mass update form, including hidden inputs and context.

methods.name: handleMassUpdate
methods.description: Processes submitted mass update data and applies changes to the selected records.

methods.name: getMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Returns the complete mass update form HTML, optionally hiding delete button if no editable fields are available.

methods.name: getFunctionValue
methods.description: Invokes a user-defined function to generate dynamic form field options.

methods.name: endMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Returns the closing form tag for the mass update form.

methods.name: handleRelationship
methods.description: Generates popup HTML for linked module relationships, such as accounts, contacts, and users.

methods.name: addParent
methods.description: Creates an HTML snippet for a parent record selection popup.

methods.name: addInputType
methods.description: Adds a basic text input field for mass update.

methods.name: addUserName
methods.description: Creates a popup interface for selecting a user or contact and populating respective fields.

methods.name: addGenericModuleID
methods.description: Creates a popup for selecting linked records from generic modules (e.g., Contact, Releases).

methods.name: addAccountID
methods.description: Creates a popup interface for selecting account records.

methods.name: addAssignedUserID
methods.description: Builds a user assignment popup for mass updating assign-to fields.

methods.name: addStatus
methods.description: Generates a dropdown for selecting status options.

methods.name: addBool
methods.description: Creates a boolean checkbox dropdown.

methods.name: addStatusMulti
methods.description: Creates a multi-select list for status options.

methods.name: addDate
methods.description: Renders a date picker input control.

methods.name: addRadioenumItem
methods.description: Builds an individual radio button input.

methods.name: addRadioenum
methods.description: Creates a set of radio buttons for options.

methods.name: addDatetime
methods.description: Generates datetime picker HTML.

methods.name: date_to_dateTime
methods.description: Converts date fields to datetime format, preserving time.

methods.name: checkClearField
methods.description: Handles clearing of checkbox fields in mass update.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clauses for search filters based on user input.

methods.name: getSearchDefs
methods.description: Loads search definitions from module metadata files.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Loads search fields configurations for modules.

methods.name: doMassUpdateFieldsExistForFocus
methods.description: Checks if focus (bean) has any fields suitable for mass update, excluding system and certain core fields.

methods.name: addDefault
methods.description: Placeholder method to be overridden in subclasses to generate custom HTML for fields.
